description: Register a new machine on the PCC network. Provide machine details to create a registration record. Include `operator` ({walletAddress, displayName, email}): without it the registration is recorded as operator 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 / "Unknown", and prove cannot match it to you.

category.description: Machine category (e.g. fdm, cnc, laser-cut, hplc)

operator.description: Who owns this machine. prove and activate match the caller against operator.walletAddress (or operator.email).

name: onboard_machine
